evidence: On upstream/main c8ab714, bin/solr contains no lsof startup probe. The report shows lsof 4.78 rejecting its TCP:LISTEN selector on CentOS 5, an obsolete environment and diagnostic-tool incompatibility rather than a current Solr defect.

JIRA raises unresolved questions about facet-query filterCache usage and cache statistics but gives no request/counter trace. Need a current-main request pair with cache metrics, comparing queryResultCache enabled and disabled, to distinguish a metrics defect from expected caching behavior.

The ticket concerns legacy cores:<n replica-placement rules, which are absent from upstream/main c8ab714; current collection assignment uses the placement-plugin API. The reporter also accepted that cores:<1 is an impossible postcondition for creating a replica.

On upstream/main c8ab714, Assign.assignCoreNodeName uses the collection-wide ZooKeeper counter. Assign.incAndGetId updates it with a versioned setData and retries BadVersionException, so concurrent replica creation cannot allocate the same counter value.

The only JIRA comment guesses at a stale write.lock or multiple cores sharing a data directory; the attached log/config needed to confirm that diagnosis is unavailable here. The reported OverlappingFileLockException alone does not establish whether this is Solr or deployment configuration.

The failure stack is in Lucene50DocValuesProducer while merging grouped facet terms, and later comments report it across Solr 5.3 through 6.6 with reindexing changing the symptom. I have not established the status of the corresponding Lucene codec path on current main, so this needs Lucene-side verification before clearing.

This is a request for a new runtime query-parameter syntax inside QTs because XML ${...} substitution is configuration-time property expansion. The ticket proposes syntax rather than showing a regression in a supported feature.

JIRA maintainers rejected globally replacing localhost with 127.0.0.1 because that breaks IPv6-only configurations. The report does not identify a reproducible Solr code path; the requested global behavior change is not a valid fix.

The JIRA comment traces the old duplicate counts to tfloat Trie precisionStep behavior and says the ordinary float field avoids it. On upstream/main c8ab714, SimpleFacets.getNumericHidingWrapper handles single-valued numeric group facets by wrapping the field with NumericHidingLeafReader for term-based grouping.
This asks to rename CloudSolrServer.setIdField to setRouteField for API clarity. The current SolrJ source has no CloudSolrServer or setIdField API, and the ticket reports no routing behavior defect.

On upstream/main c8ab714, MoreLikeThisHandler constructs a non-null ResponseBuilder before passing it to SimpleFacets and FacetComponent, removing the old null-builder path behind the reported NPE. The JIRA comment also says the request parameters were chosen incorrectly.

The reported workflow replaces Lucene index files on disk while the core is open, then reloads the core. That is external mutation of a live index/writer rather than a supported Solr index replacement operation, so the symptom does not identify a Solr defect.
The JIRA explicitly describes this as a parent for improvements to the experimental JSON Facet API before its planned 5.2 finalization. It is an umbrella feature ticket, not a specific bug.

On upstream/main c8ab714, CloudSolrStream initializes eofTuples as Collections.synchronizedMap(new HashMap<>()). This protects the concurrent EOF insertions during parallel stream opening that the ticket describes.

JIRA commenters identify eDisMax parsing/default-field differences, but the final discussion also raises a possible regression of SOLR-3377. The ticket lacks the schema and complete parser parameters needed to decide; a minimal current-main reproduction is still required.
The JIRA component is clients - C# and the report concerns how a C# client renders highlighter tags around special characters. No Solr server code path or server-side behavior defect is identified.
This is a request to add a spatial dataset and example schema to the examples, with no malfunction reported; its JIRA fix version is 5.0. It is an example/documentation enhancement, not a bug.

SplitShardCmd still creates sub-shard replicas on upstream/main c8ab714, but the ticket gives no configset contents, custom-lib path, or node-local deployment details. Without those, the class-loading failure cannot be separated from inconsistent plugin deployment across nodes.

The reported partial-term highlighting depends on the field analyzer, query parser, and hl.* settings, none of which are included. Without that configuration or a reproducer, the output cannot distinguish a highlighter defect from expected token-boundary behavior.

The ticket concerns TestLBHttpSolrServer and its CloserThread, but upstream/main no longer contains that client implementation or test; the only LBHttpSolrServer occurrence is a historical comment in LBSolrClient. The reported test path is obsolete.
